title: Student Power allowance petition march attempt on 8 and 15 August
reason: The sources say police refused permission on 8 August and a second petition-delivery attempt on 15 August failed. They do not establish a march/protest that proceeded or a 50-person gathering.
notes: Record only the attempted, blocked actions; do not treat plans/signatures as simultaneous event attendance.
